other_conditions: The family must reside in one of the selected Shaheed villages.
The family must live in a kutcha house.
The family should not have availed any housing scheme benefits in the last 5 years.
Priority is given to descendants of freedom fighters from the selected villages.
benefits_summary: Housing assistance of ₹2,63,000 per family along with infrastructure development such as roads, drains, Anganwadi centres, libraries, sports resources, solar lamps, piped water supply, and cooking gas connections.
